summary: Operational evidence claimed for a window whose gaps are undocumented. A month in which the failure a claim is about never happened is the gap.

workload.description: Whatever the depending workload sent during the window.

measurement.method: Production telemetry aggregated over the observation window.

productionContext.organization: An organization operating the platform for its own users.
productionContext.dependingWorkload: A product feature whose users depended on the service during the window.

limitations: One organization, one window, one workload. A month of operation in which a failure never happened says nothing about that failure.
doesNotEstablish: Future performance, or behaviour under failure modes that did not occur during the window.
